name: 🏕️ Safar & Media Stats Inspector
description: Windows File Explorer Shell Extension for Safar folders: displays Total Days, Event breakdown (Q, N, Z, MZ, AQ, ZO, etc.), Premiere Pro timeline duration, and 1-click WhatsApp executive reports.
author: UniDesk / BS.Framework

settings.name: showFullNamesByDefault
settings.description: When enabled, full names like 'Nikah' and 'Majmui Ziyafat' are shown instead of abbreviations ('N', 'MZ').

settings.name: enableContextMenu
settings.description: Add 'Inspect Safar & Media Stats' to Explorer folder right-click context menu.

settings.name: enableHotkey
settings.description: Press Ctrl+Shift+S in Explorer to inspect the currently selected folder.

settings.name: pythonGuiPath
settings.description: Absolute path to the python workstation dashboard script.
